how: A fresh session loads the skill, treats each fixture as this week's Meta Ads export for one client with the ads-plan below, and runs the Rules. Compare the flag it raises for the named ad or cell with expected. Record the run in runs.md.

cases.expected_action: keep on the Watch list; no verdict on any metric
no winner called; both cells below 50 results; an early read may be shown as raw numbers headed 'too small to call'
cases.rule: Winner: minimum sample in both cells AND >= 50 results per cell AND >= 30 % gap

cases.expected_action: two of three signals turned (frequency > 3, CTR down 26 %); CPR up 8 % does not count; recommend a refresh for human approval
cases.rule: Fatigue when two of three turn together

cases.expected_action: no edit, no pause; revisit after day 7
cases.rule: Learning phase: don't judge or edit ads < 7 days old

cases.expected_action: not paused even though cost per result is above target; note it; only disapproval or overspend ends it early
cases.rule: Planned tests: don't pause before the end date
